title: Travelling to Malaysia-Questions & Tips
body:
O.P.
In the spirit of the Thailand and Bali Questions & Tips threads which have been very popular, here is my suggestion for a Malaysian Travel general purpose thread.
Given how cheap it is to get to and around Malaysia with AirAsia, I am surprised that a general thread hasn't popped up earlier. It has been a while since there was much talk about Malaysia here and it is spread across quite a few smaller threads. So here goes with my initial contribution:
We travelled to Malaysia as a family last year and like all other AirAsia travellers, we got to enjoy the wonderful "character" of LCCT. I am glad to see (like many others around here surely) that it is due to be replaced soon by a new modern terminal "KLIA 2" which is currently being constructed not far from the main terminal and on the opposite side of the apron from LCCT.
An opening date of June 28 has been reported by the owners which is a day before we are due to arrive there on our next holiday. As recently as yesterday, the owners were claiming that the June 28 date is still on track, however, other experts claim otherwise see links below:
http://www.thesundaily.my/ne ws/686799 http://www.thesundaily.my/news/683359
Personally, I'm not holding my breath on landing at KLIA2 this year, and suspect that the first I will hear of it not opening on time is when others report here after arriving at LCCT on the 28th.
Does anyone here have any inside information? Anyone able to report on what they have seen of the site as they have landed in KL?
Of course, please share any other thoughts, comments, tips and questions about Malaysia.
MacMaddog

http://www.thesundaily.my/news/691154
Malaysia Airports Holdings Bhd (MAHB) has come out to say that it may have difficulty in meeting the June 28, 2013 deadline for the opening of the new RM4 billion low-cost carrier terminal in Sepang (KLIA2), despite the earlier commitment given by its contractors.
It didn't take long for an answer to my question. I guess I'll get to enjoy the hospitality of LCCT one more time.
On a completely different note, we will be staying at Concorde Hotel KL in their family room, due to our previous favorite, Crowne Plaza, closing its doors earlier this year. Does anyone have any experiences of the family room, or Concorde in general to report?
